column3: Splits the web shell into index and cache-stable vendor chunks; assets sorted into langs/ and fonts/ by exact package names.
Extracts the anonymous UUID into a shared package used by OTel, /feedback acknowledgement and the DeepSeek user-id header.
Coalesces session-event appends into a fixed 200 ms window per write handle, bounded coalescing not debounce.
Moves tool-call presentation into dsh-client-ui-tool; conversation keeps only call/result pairing and topology.
One preset composition per process under a standing scope; agents bind to it through the scope parent chain.
Extends the independent AST exhaustiveness scan from services to cordis events, fail-closed in three directions.
Defines the headless profile as a direct core entry point: stdout text, exit 0 only on a completed turn reason.
Skill registry becomes a host singleton layered per scope; nearest layer wins outright, rank only orders within one layer.
Editable per-message feedback in a session sidecar row bound to the header identity, with per-item CAS versions.
Product sub-agent providers stay host-plane process registrations; presets contribute only ordinary tool rows.
One client verb ctx.remote.$on over a single allowlist; event signatures come from one cordis Events declaration.
Moves unary browser operations off the API Proxy onto owning business Remote services; API Proxy service deleted.
Deletes three command-line seams in favour of existing interfaces; --dev and the conditional reload row are gone.
Loader interpolates the entry disabled field with !!js so a row gates itself on platform; Windows patch layer deleted.
Trajectory rebuilt on the shared conversation assembler with target-owned definitions; prepend costs O(P x D + M).
Carries packed chunk rows over history transport; 416,756 events became 696 records, 90.8% less JSON.
Projection cache becomes one version-stamped document per session in a per-record storage domain; no cold-refold ladder.
Splits projection host state from client views into two typed tables; the persist opt-in is removed.
Replaces Session.events with seq, eventAt(seq) and explicit snapshotEvents, so scalar reads never copy the log.
Centralises system-prompt section order in a live service; spacing of ten and name-based tie-break.
Preset health resolves rows on disk instead of importing them; 14 ms roster read versus 2.45 s through import.meta.resolve.
Native managed ranges (systemd scope, Windows Job) contain escaped descendants; no PID and no public startup state.
Live assistant stream frames stay separate from the durable log; branded attempt id, staged settlement matching.
Folds the activity observation registry into ctx.jobs; one record per job, no end call, constant-resource pump.
acceptIdentity only narrows, so an empty or null continuation delta cannot erase a tool call's identity.
Model listings read per protocol; Anthropic page cap 1000 documented, both reply shapes parsed without UA spoofing.
Plugins settings becomes one navigation row with feature-owned tabs contributed through the settings.plugins.tab slot.
Persistent PowerShell shell on Windows: one terminal backend with two dialects, marker readiness, exact native exit codes.
Input modalities resolve entry then catalog then route default; undeclared means text, catalog outranks the route fallback.
Deleting the settings namespace allowlists: registering is exposing, keyed slot dispatch makes absence the signal.
Session content search off by default via the provider's openAt never phase, with a typed SESSION_QUERY_SEARCH_DISABLED code.
Framework-free web boot kernel, a dynamic ui-renderer plugin, slot-based attachments and effect-scoped theme CSS.
One settings.describe mirror replaces fifteen browser readers; startup reads drop 15 to 2 with a pinned budget.
DSH_CLIENT_* is the only build-time public namespace; one define generator serves Vite and the tsdown client preset.
Four Agent Teams packages publish under experimental npm names; stable packages may not depend on them.
SQLite schema 20 packs chunk runs into physical rows; 2.5M events to 65,810 rows, 89.4% smaller, full durability pinned.
Experimental packages must carry the dsh-experimental- npm prefix, enforced by a workspace constraints gate.
Per-PR Cloudflare Pages preview behind Access; byte-level verification of the served image and a committed bin link target.
Composer rebuilt on Lexical with chips as atomic decorator nodes; three projections, machine slims to the submit plane.
Worker gains a Node face: proxied builtins, an in-memory VFS with real stat semantics, and a child-worker shell.
Pack-time module lowering only; preview is the served page plus one tag and a base image with restricted overlays.
CDP endpoint moves to a Worker so DevTools survives a paused host; one realm registry serves host and client objects.
Python SDK launches the ordinary dsh CLI with a profile; explicit home required, ESM proxies replace symlinks in pkg.
Windows x64 SDK runtime target with its own wheel tag, native payloads and installed-wheel blackbox lane.
Worker gains a VFS mutation source, npm-compatible watchers and a Landlock CLI protocol over per-process grants.
Cordis runtime tree as a CDP-independent snapshot model; five distinct identities kept for their different owners.
sdk-minimal is a standalone profile with an explicit roster and no dsh-base, so nothing is hidden rather than absent.
Standard Zstandard level for JSONL after measuring level 19 costs on a 501-session corpus: 12.1% bytes for 129.8% fork time.
Renames code mode to PTC across config, presets and events while deferring the durable session vocabulary.
Inspector source layout makes the execution realm explicit; client and host trees mirror each other exactly.
Client-local submission echo correlated by the existing rpcId; durable admission timing unchanged, composer never freezes.
Models page declares a keyed provider-card slot and a footer slot so out-of-tree plugins can extend it.
Two development overlays mount the private inspector without any published manifest entry or launcher flag.
One process-table snapshot per poll replaces N+1 reads; signal fencing deliberately keeps a fresh per-target liveness read.
Plugin inventory reports preset compositions too, evaluating file gates without importing or mounting anything.
Splits session positions into SessionSeq and SessionLogOffset brands with a separate isSeeded header bit.
One shared IntersectionObserver activates highlighting once per block; leaving the viewport never deactivates it.
391-line naming contract: a role-word table with use/do-not-use columns plus a former-to-current rename ledger and non-renames.
Image offload becomes a durable surfaceOp replacement so the model-visible prefix only advances and stays reconstructable from the log.
Declares compatibleVersions and backup-and-skip so a v3-v6 projection-cache home boots without serving an unproven value.
Harness manifest declarations move to one type-only package that exports no runtime values.
Record-level readers answer consumer questions from compact assistant streams; first-open projection drops 28ms to 5.9ms.
One injected useTabInfo reader plus responsive width rules: shrink the right column, then close it, before shrinking the conversation.
One dual-face workspace-files package; two named type-level dependency directions keep the compiler graph acyclic.
Root-scoped keyed main slot and sidebar.panellist; extension panels add no navigation or reserved space by default.
Release compatibility comparison moves to packaging; startup keeps only the reads it needs.
Desktop shows the window before host startup so progress and recovery are visible; one serving start, no staged probe.
Desktop modifies the profile in place; no staging, journal or rollback, and partial changes are kept for repair.
Plugin management becomes a sidebar entry and main panel; installs are correlated by a fresh per-request id.
Commands get a branded definitionId; the composer owns the File action so one availability query drives menu and invocation.
Local Office preview through a WASM LibreOffice worker; fonts are requested before substitution and PDFs stay out of the session.
One searchable PTC runtime vocabulary across packages, services, config and docs; run_code keeps its descriptive name.
Per-session layout snapshot plus provider-owned content recovery; a restored identity never authorises a new process.
No runtime import of pi-ai's aggregate entry; profile proves 153 pi-ai modules and no TypeBox.
Exactly one Office engine per platform from the kit's optionalDependencies; a missing native package never falls back to WASM.
Official COS SDK, one streamed PUT per object so a write cannot repeat; the empty Cache-Control header is stripped.
Plugin configuration moves onto the Plugins page via three slots; Settings keeps the read-only inventory.
Plugin detail pages expose three region-keyed list slots; the subject is a projection, not the page store.
